newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada dollar closes softer on rate fears.
newsitem.headline: Canada dollar closes softer on rate fears.

text.p: * Canada's dollar closed weaker at C$1.3518 (US$0.7398) from Thursday's close at C$1.3503 (US$0.7406), with most of the weakness coming overnight and during morning trading on fears of a Bank of Canada cut in interest rates, dealers said. * Market players gave the currency back some strength during the afternoon after the Bank of Canada failed to cut.
Market players are still watching the central bank closely however after disappointing Canadian employment data on Friday, said dealers.
A Reuters survey of economists had forecast the unemployment rate to drop to 9.3 percent and employment to grow by 37,000 in September.
But full-time employment fell by 86,000, wiping out the 72,000 gain in August and cutting the year's total gains in half.
"We believe there's an opportunity for another ease here," said Wateridge.
On the crosses, Canada's dollar fell to 1.1313 marks from Thursday's close of 1.1316 marks but rose to 82.44 yen from 83.35 yen.
